packageRules.description: Group minor and patch updates to runtime libraries. Later rules move development tooling, images and language toolchains out of this group.
Group minor and patch updates to development, test and CI tooling apart from runtime libraries.
Poetry and Pipenv name their dependency types after the project's own groups, such as `lint` or `docs`, so match everything but the runtime ones.
CI workflows and pre-commit hooks are development tooling too.

Group minor and patch updates to container images and Helm charts, such as datastores and exporters, apart from libraries. custom.nip-publication is where publication-age-containers moves the images and charts it ages.
Versions pinned inside a Dockerfile, such as ENV and ARG pins, are part of the image, so review them with its base image.
Upgrade Node.js in one PR: .nvmrc, engines, setup-node and the node image move together.
Upgrade Python in one PR: .python-version, requires-python, setup-python and the python image move together.
